boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten distinct named destinations on Athens corridors immediately beyond Ohio University’s campus.

cards.title: Athena Cinema
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the current showtime schedule, then photograph the 20 South Court marquee before heading inside for an evening screening.
cards.short_summary: A Court Street cinema with daily-changing showtimes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athena Cinema is at 20 S. Court St.; Ohio University identifies it as a commercial movie theater in the evenings.
cards.access_notes: Current showtimes and ticket details are posted by the cinema.

cards.title: Athens County Courthouse
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the courthouse clock and red-brick façade at Court and Washington, then continue along the Uptown sidewalks.
cards.short_summary: A working 1880 courthouse at the foot of Court Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Supreme Court says the Athens County Courthouse was built in 1880 and sits at 1 South Court Street.
cards.source_title: Ohio Courthouses | Supreme Court of Ohio
cards.access_notes: This is an active government building; follow posted entry and security rules.

cards.title: Bagel Street Deli
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 27 South Court Street location as a lunch stop and choose from the shop’s bagelwich menu before walking onward.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated bagel-sandwich stop on South Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel Street Deli’s official site lists its Athens location at 27 S. Court Street.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current service details with the business.

cards.title: Court Street Coffee
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Meet at the Uptown café at 67 South Court Street and use its posted daytime hours to plan a coffee or study break.
cards.short_summary: A café with a clearly listed Uptown location and hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Court Street Coffee lists its Uptown café at 67 South Court Street and publishes its current weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: The business lists Uptown hours as weekdays 7 a.m.–6 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Fluff Bakery
cards.subtitle: North Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 8 North Court Street for the bakery case or brunch menu, and check the posted schedule before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A North Court bakery serving pastries, breakfast, lunch, and brunch.
cards.evidence_claim: Fluff Bakery lists its address as 8 N. Court Street and says it serves fresh pastries, breakfast, lunch, and brunch.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Tuesday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Donkey Coffee and Espresso
cards.subtitle: West Washington Street corridor, one block from Court Street
cards.notes: Walk one block west from Court Street to the 17½ West Washington address for coffee, pastries, art, and free Wi‑Fi.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street coffee shop with several rooms and free Wi‑Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Donkey Coffee lists its location at 17½ W. Washington Street and describes 150 seats, six rooms, art, music, and free wireless access.
cards.access_notes: The business posts hours through midnight daily; purchases are available on site.

cards.title: Passion Works Studio
cards.subtitle: East State Street corridor, beside the Court Street intersection
cards.notes: Visit the 20 East State Street studio to see collaborative artwork, browse the gallery, or ask about volunteering opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative arts studio just off the Court Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Passion Works Studio lists its studio at 20 East State Street and invites visitors and volunteers.
cards.access_notes: The studio lists visitor hours Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Casa Nueva Restaurant & Cantina
cards.subtitle: West State Street corridor, beside the Court Street intersection
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s 6 West State Street carryout or dine-in service for a meal, and check its posted weekly schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A State Street restaurant offering food, music, and art programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Nueva lists its address as 6 W. State Street and says it serves local food, music, and art in Appalachian Ohio.
cards.access_notes: Dine-in and carryout hours are posted as 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Athens Public Library
cards.subtitle: Home Street corridor, just north of Court Street
cards.notes: Head to 30 Home Street for public computers, Wi‑Fi, meeting rooms, bike checkouts, or the ongoing used-book sale.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch with workspaces, Wi‑Fi, and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Athens County Public Libraries lists the Athens branch at 30 Home Street with Wi‑Fi, public computers, meeting rooms, and bike checkouts.
cards.source_title: Athens Public Library | Athens County Public Libraries
cards.access_notes: The branch lists Monday–Thursday hours of 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday–Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Village Bakery and Café
cards.subtitle: East State Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue east on State Street to 268 East State for breads, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and daily plates made around local ingredients.
cards.short_summary: An East State bakery-café with breads, pastries, and savory food.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Bakery and Café lists its address at 268 East State Street and describes breads, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and daily plates.
cards.access_notes: The café posts Tuesday–Friday 8 a.m.–6 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–3 p.m., and Sunday brunch 9 a.m.–2 p.m.
